about: Who voices the lines in Data/voice_lines.json when they are made with ElevenLabs (scripts/windows/make_elevenlabs_voices.py). The ids are voices of the ElevenLabs voice library, all native Korean speakers; they are not secrets. The API key is not kept here: it is read from the ELEVENLABS_API_KEY environment variable. Library voices need a paid plan when used through the API (Starter since 2026-11-10).
decided: 2026-11-10, 시험 음성과 적용본을 보낸 뒤 사용자가 이 배역 그대로 쓰기로 했다.
